Does the migration move legacy few:poll-votes:{pollId} rows to the group-scoped key correctly (groupId recovered from the poll store), idempotently, without losing or duplicating votes, and drop rows whose poll is unknown or ambiguous (tested)?

Are early votes queued per (groupId, pollId), bounded, and applied with the full receive-side validation when the poll-open arrives (AC-9), with queued votes for a closed or never-arriving poll handled deterministically?
Does parsePollOpen reject polls exceeding the creation-side option-count and length caps on receipt?
Is the stale AC-9 close-tally sentence corrected and docs/behavior/polls.md updated for the new behaviour?
Unit suite + tsc green; Stryker (concurrency 1) on pollHandler/pollPersistence/pollSync shows no real-gap survivors in touched code; polls e2e specs pass on a wiped relay?
